frontend.line: Sign-in redirect loop: any new public page (e.g. /pricing) and /login must be in the publicRoutes matcher in apps/web/middleware.ts (Clerk protects all else), and afterSignInUrl must be /dashboard (NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_AFTER_SIGN_IN_URL). Staging loop from PR #828 (Lena's (auth) route group) is Lena's to fix; do not touch.
State: server state TanStack Query, client state zustand stores colocated with the feature (e.g. useInvoiceEditorStore); never mix. No Redux (ADR 0009; Lena wanted it for the invoice editor).
Tailwind v4 CSS-first config in apps/web/app/globals.css (@theme tokens); never create tailwind.config.js; use theme tokens (ring-primary), not hard-coded colors.
Dates: timestamps stored UTC; UI converts via next-intl useFormatter with user's timeZone (providers.tsx); due dates use formatDueDate (browser tz), dueDate plain YYYY-MM-DD parsed local.

Money: format via formatMoney (apps/web/lib/money.ts) which rounds on decimal string (Number(`${amount}e2`)) since Math.round(amount*100) gave 2.005 -> 2.00; most callers pass cents/100, proper fix is formatting from integer cents; round each line to whole cents before summing.

Invoice.lineItems only present when request passes expand=lineItems (cached list rows lack it, detail crashes on .map; Sentry WEB-1F3); guard it or always request expand=lineItems (proposed, unconfirmed). Only status=open invoices can be overdue.
Forms use react-hook-form + zodResolver (@hookform/resolvers/zod); examples invoice-form.tsx, org-form.tsx, client-form.tsx.
Import paths must match file name case exactly (macOS case-insensitive, Linux CI fails 'Module not found').

Jordan's trailmix app (Django+htmx): only the form carries hx-* (no extra hx-post on button); hx-disabled-elt, hx-sync="this:drop"; uploads need hx-encoding=multipart/form-data; POSTs need CSRF via <body hx-headers> in base.html; Django test client skips CSRF, so check in a browser.
Web stack: Next.js 13.5.6 pages router; auth is Auth0 (@auth0/nextjs-auth0) per docs/architecture.md, though Clerk middleware/keys still appear (conflict); next-auth is an unused leftover.
Icon-only buttons need aria-label (icon aria-hidden); use shadcn/ui from apps/web/components/ui and lucide-react, not hand-rolled icons; sweep of other unlabelled buttons deferred.
Only NEXT_PUBLIC_ env vars reach browser; Stripe one must be pk_ (publishable); .env.example has NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY=sk_test_replace_me (Lena), flagged not renamed.
InvoiceStatusBadge props: status (draft|sent|paid|overdue|void; renamed from kind) and size sm|md; invoice.kind means one-off vs recurring; labels via next-intl. Storybook on 6006.
UI copy: no exclamation marks in empty states; button label 'New invoice' everywhere, never 'Create invoice'.
PR #479 (acme-447-invoices-empty-state) needs rendering tests for empty/error/loading; error beats empty. InvoicesEmptyState is reusable; shared EmptyState in packages/ui is a separate future effort.

Analytics: track() in apps/web/lib/analytics.ts (PostHog); add events to AnalyticsEvent union; tracked invoice_created, invoice_sent, revenue_range_changed; status filter clicks untracked (Sam asked 2026-09-11; suggest invoice_status_filter_changed).

Never leak secrets/tokens in logs or error messages; logger redacts auth headers, cookies, password/token/secret/apiKey; scrubMessage() strips Bearer tokens.

code-style.line: Never mix TanStack Query (server) and zustand (client, colocated stores); no Redux (ADR 0009).
Logging: pino only (req.log / request.log in api, shared logger in worker); no console.log; never log whole request bodies; redact secrets/tokens.
Node is 20.11 since 2026-08-27 (engines >=20.11 <21), earlier Node 18 API ban lifted. All packages are ESM ("type": "module"): no require(), use import.

Lint/format is Biome only (ESLint/Prettier dropped, PR #512): `pnpm lint`, `pnpm biome check --write <path>`, width 120; never add .eslintrc.json/.prettierrc (Lena's PR added them to apps/api; ask her to delete).
Tailwind v4 CSS-first; theme tokens, no tailwind.config.js.
Validation is zod everywhere (no joi, no hand-rolled ifs); schemas in apps/api/src/schemas/; routes use safeParse, 400 invalid_body.
Data-access naming: list* functions (getInvoicesForClient renamed listClientInvoices).
CLI uses commander (replaced yargs in #409): each group exports registerX(program). TypeScript strict with noUncheckedIndexedAccess (NodeNext): indexing returns T | undefined.
No emojis in code, commit messages or docs.
Icon-only buttons need aria-label; use shadcn/ui and lucide-react.
Use @acme/shared/... path aliases (@acme/* -> packages/*/src), not deep relative imports.
CLI errors: throw UsageError (exit 2) for bad flags, never process.exit in handlers; others print message and exit 1 (packages/cli/src/lib/errors.ts).
Components under 150 lines with colocated tests; re-check for bugs/security before done.
CLI uses picocolors, not chalk; ui/table.ts pads by String.length so ANSI misaligns (pad on visible width).
Tests are vitest only; no jest/jest-dom.
CLI prompts via @clack/prompts; destructive commands confirm (-y/--yes, default No, exit 2 non-TTY).
Never put secrets in NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars.

api.line: API is Fastify 5 (migrated from Express 4, PR #412, api 3.0.0): middleware are plugins in apps/api/src/plugins/ (auth, cors, rate-limit, request-id, error-handler); handlers take (request, reply); requireAuth verifies Clerk JWTs, 401 token_expired / invalid_token.
CORS only origins in CORS_ORIGINS env (comma-separated); no-Origin requests pass.
Validation zod only; schemas in apps/api/src/schemas/, safeParse -> 400 invalid_body.
Keep connectRetryWindowMs >= 120_000 (RDS failover 90s). PgBouncer transaction mode: prepare:false, driver doesn't pass it to raw pool yet.
Invoice endpoint includes lineItems only with expand=lineItems; only open invoices can be overdue.
CLI: `acme login` device flow, token in keytar; `--bom` for CSV; ACME_API_URL; apiGet retries 502/503/504 (staging 502s ~40s on deploys).
Every table has org_id; every query must filter by req.auth.orgId. JSON camelCase (totalCents); convert SUM() DECIMAL strings to numbers.
Public rate limit: @fastify/rate-limit plugin, 100/min per IP counted in Redis, /healthz exempt.
Webhooks signed HMAC SHA-256 in X-Acme-Signature: t=<ts>,v1=<hex> over '<ts>.<raw body>' (webhooks/sign.ts).
Request id plugin: x-request-id (or UUID) on every log as requestId and echoed on response; web doesn't send it, Sentry not tagged.
Search uses Postgres tsvector columns (drizzle/0031_clients_search.sql), not Elasticsearch; add no search service.
Money: unit prices integer cents; round each line to whole cents before summing (fractional quantities).
Invoice numbers (INV-0042) from invoice_counters; nextInvoiceNumber(tx, orgId) must run inside the insert transaction.
Drizzle: load relations explicitly via `with:` to avoid N+1; unfixed in routes/payments/list.ts, routes/clients/list.ts.
